name: TriviumDB
author: DJLegends
description: Embedded vector, knowledge-graph, BM25 full-text and TQL database engine (TriviumDB 0.9.0) for other Project Σ extensions: window.__SIGMA_TRIVIUM__.db and triviumdb.* commands in the page, globalThis.__SIGMA_TRIVIUM_SERVER__ (namespaces + embeddings through your connections) for server halves. Its view is a debug workbench with a meaning test for embedding connections. Smart Recall is the example extension built on it.
